name: Shenyang Machine Tool Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenyang Machine Tool Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides metal cutting machine tools in China and internationally. The company offers vertical and horizontal machining centers; vertical, horizontal, and economical CNC lathes; vertical, gantry, and horizontal 5-axis machining centers; and automation and industry products. It also provides metal forming machine tools, CNC planer-type and floor-type milling and boring machines, gantry machining centers, CNC heavy-duty hydraulic presses and complete production line equipment, digital assembly line products, conventional drilling machines, and other products, as well as supporting technical services.
